summary: Iteration 134 - Frontend testing for MoltBot Canvas Editor UX improvements: simplified toolbar, multi-select, mobile panel behavior, template import, and navigation. All 7 requested features PASS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 requested UX features verified working in MoltBot Canvas Editor. Simplified toolbar hides advanced tools by default, multi-select checkboxes work in LayersPanel, AlignmentToolbar shows selection count, ExportImportDialog has 3 template buttons, mobile panel collapsed by default with toggle, live sync toggle in advanced tools, navigation between pages works without freeze.

simplified_toolbar_default.details: Advanced tools (نسخ، لصق، تكرار، حذف، معاينة حية) hidden by default. Only basic tools visible until 'أدوات +' clicked.

advanced_tools_toggle.details: Clicking 'أدوات +' button reveals advanced tools group with copy, paste, duplicate, delete, live sync, and shortcuts buttons.

live_sync_in_advanced_tools.details: Live sync toggle 'معاينة حية' found inside advanced tools group (only visible after clicking 'أدوات +').

multi_select_checkboxes_layers_panel.details: Found 2 multi-select checkboxes in Layers Panel. Clicking multiple checkboxes selects multiple items.

alignment_toolbar_selection_count.details: Alignment toolbar shows 'تحديد متعدد: 2' when 2 items selected via checkboxes. 3 alignment buttons present.

export_import_templates.details: Export/Import menu contains template section with 3 template buttons: 'قالب KPI Dashboard', 'قالب صفحة العملاء', 'قالب صفحة التقارير'.

mobile_panel_collapsed_default.details: On mobile viewport (390x844), right panel has 'mobile-collapsed' class by default. Toggle button 'إظهار اللوحة' visible. After click, panel opens with 'mobile-open' class and button text changes to 'إخفاء اللوحة'.

navigation_no_freeze.details: Navigation between /moltbot, /operations, /customers works without crash or freeze. All pages load correctly.
